en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of striking vertical basalt columns forming a cliff, with scattered rocks at the base. The text at the bottom provides information about the site, identifying it as 'Les Orgues de Montrodeix'—a natural geological formation known for its columnar basalt structures. The scene is natural, without human-made structures, and some trees are visible at the top of the cliffs.
